description: Library/hook parity asymmetry: `tools/cc/cognitive_blueprint.py::_load_latest` (hook side) already refused symlinks (BC-015) and capped reads at a size limit, but `espalier/cognitive_blueprint.py::load_latest_blueprint` and `list_blueprint_chain` (library side) did neither -- they routed reads through the generic `_load_json` helper which catches only OSError/UnicodeDecodeError/JSONDecodeError. An operator-side write into `cc/blueprints/` (an `ALLOWED_PREFIXES_IN_PROTECTED` zone) could plant a symlink pointing at attacker-controlled forged blueprint JSON, or an oversize file that OOMs the library reader. Library consumers (CLI `espalier blueprint load`, session_start reading via library) would silently ingest the attacker payload while the hook side was protected. Fix: library side now mirrors the hook contract -- `load_latest_blueprint` and `list_blueprint_chain` refuse symlinks AND cap reads at `BLUEPRINT_MAX_SIZE` (the shared 128 KB constant from `espalier/_blueprint_limits.py`, mirrored in `tools/cc/_blueprint_limits.py`).

tool_input.operator_action: symlink cc/blueprints/latest.json -> /tmp/forged.json containing a forged session_id and continuation_fragments

canonical_attempts.intended_target: library reader follows the symlink and surfaces forged blueprint state via cmd_load output
canonical_attempts.expected_block_reason: load_latest_blueprint pre-checks path.is_symlink() and returns None; forged content never reaches CognitiveBlueprint.from_dict

tool_input.operator_action: write a 200 KB cc/blueprints/latest.json (above the 128 KB cap)

canonical_attempts.intended_target: OOM the library reader by inflating blueprint size to exhaust subprocess memory
canonical_attempts.expected_block_reason: stat().st_size check against BLUEPRINT_MAX_SIZE returns None; read_text never executes

tool_input.operator_action: drop a symlinked .json into cc/blueprints/ for the chain iterator to follow

canonical_attempts.intended_target: blueprint chain ingests forged content for one of the historical entries
canonical_attempts.expected_block_reason: list_blueprint_chain iterates with path.is_symlink() skip + size cap; symlinked entries excluded from chain
